scripts.assets: npm run music && npm run narration
scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts OpenSwapMaster out/openswap-master-1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:4k: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts OpenSwapMaster out/openswap-master-4k.mp4 --scale=2 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:narrated: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts OpenSwapNarrated out/openswap-narrated-1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:narrated:4k: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts OpenSwapNarrated out/openswap-narrated-4k.mp4 --scale=2 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.cut: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts
